text:
sam: hitting 'no available IPs' + pod scheduling failures on our westus4 GPU nodepool. jobs queueing. we need a quota bump for GPUs and bigger secondary IP range for the gpu nodepool. 😬
anya: what's the project and exact numbers you want to request?
sam: project: redwood-prod-us. current GPU capacity in westus4 is 8 A100s. request +40 A100 (target 48 total) to support batch inference. also need secondary-range increase: add ~2048 IPs to the subnet used by gpu-nodepool-1 so we can raise maxPods per node.
mohit: can you paste the failing pod events / kubelet error?
sam: pod events snippet:```nEvents:
  Type     Reason              Age    From               Message
  ----     ------              ----   ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling    2m     default-scheduler  0/6 nodes are available: 6 node(s) had no available addresses.
```
And kubelet logs:```nE0321 14:05:12.123456  1234 cni.go:267] Error adding network: failed to assign pod IP: no more addresses in the range```
lee: sounds like alias IP secondary range exhausted. GKE requires you to allocate larger secondary range BEFORE raising maxPods. Temporary mitigation: create a small cpu-only nodepool with a larger alias range and move non-GPU workloads there. also we can patch the node pool template to increase --max-pods when the range is expanded.
mohit: for the quota request to GCP support include these explicit lines so they approve faster:
```nProject: redwood-prod-us
Region: us-west4
Quotas to increase:
- Accelerators (A100) in region us-west4: current 8 -> request 48 (increase by 40)
- Subnetwork secondary range for cluster 'redwood-gke-prod' (gpu-nodepool-1): increase size by 2048 ips (from /24 to /22 equivalent)
- (Optional) Increase for 'VM instances (all GPUs combined)' if flagged separately
```
anya: do we also need to request per-instance ENI / IPs-per-node limits? GCP's alias IP model controls pod IPs, but some providers have per-ENI limits.
sam: GKE uses alias IPs so the secondary range is the core thing; but on AWS we'd ask for ENI/per-eni increase. This is GCP so include secondary-range change + gpus.
lee: actionable next steps: 1) sam files the GCP quota request using above template and includes link to cluster name and nodepool (gke-prod / gpu-nodepool-1). 2) I can open a short-term PR to add a cpu nodepool with larger alias range and taints/tolerations to shift non-gpu pods off GPU nodes. 3) once GCP approves, we update nodepool max-pods and scale up GPU nodes.
quota-bot: created external support case GCP-2026-13457 for project redwood-prod-us. GCP estimated response: 48-72hrs. Case link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/GCP-2026-13457
sam: thanks — starting the request now. will post the case link and any follow-ups here. :thumbsup:
